signup_terms_intro: Mentorship in AlumVerse is a non-profit connection activity between mentor and mentee aimed at supporting learning orientation, career, and skills development. AlumVerse acts as an intermediary platform to support connections, schedule management, and feedback recording; the content exchanged during mentoring sessions is the responsibility of the participating parties.
signup_terms_agree_header: By using the Mentorship feature, users agree to:
signup_terms_commitment_1: Provide honest, clear profile information appropriate for the mentoring purpose.
signup_terms_commitment_2: Not use mentorship for advertising, solicitation, unauthorized fees, or providing services outside the platform.
signup_terms_commitment_3: Respect the other party's time, respond to bookings within a reasonable time, and notify early if cancellation or rescheduling is needed.
signup_terms_commitment_4: Keep confidential any personal information or sensitive content shared during the mentoring process.
signup_terms_commitment_5: Not use harassing language or behavior, discrimination, insults, or violation of the law.
signup_terms_commitment_6: Allow the system to record session history, feedback, and reports to improve mentorship quality and handle disputes if any.
signup_terms_penalty: If a mentor or mentee repeatedly books but does not attend, cancels multiple times, or behaves inappropriately, AlumVerse reserves the right to warn, restrict, or temporarily suspend access to the Mentorship feature.
signup_terms_accept_label: I have read and agree to the above terms
mentee_signup_commitment_1: Provide honest, clear profile information appropriate for the purpose of receiving mentoring.
mentee_signup_commitment_2: Respect the mentor's time, respond promptly, and give advance notice if cancellation or rescheduling is needed.
mentee_signup_commitment_3: Keep confidential any personal information or sensitive content shared during conversations.
mentee_signup_commitment_4: Not use harassing language or behavior, discrimination, insults, or violation of the law.
mentee_signup_commitment_5: Allow the system to store session history and evaluations to improve the program's quality.
